title: Stand Still and Watch Him Win
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
So many enemies drew near,
Jehoshaphat, afraid,
Called all the people in to pray,
And this is what he prayed:

[Chorus]
“We don’t know what to do, O Lord,
Our eyes are upon Thee,”
When I don’t know which way to go,
The Lord will fight for me.

[Verse 2]
“Don’t be afraid,” the Lord replied,
“This battle’s Mine, I say,
Stand still and watch Me save you all,”
They sang, God won the day!

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When you don’t know just what to do,
Look up to God, and rest,
Now close your eyes; He fights for you,
And keeps you safe and blessed.

[Chorus]
mood: Processional music. A slow, solemn, forward-moving pulse carries the voice like people marching out singing instead of fighting, matching Jehoshaphat's prayer and the battle the Lord fought for them. The chorus rises full and lifted, the prayer itself sung with faces turned up. By the last verse the march stands still, the pulse drops low and slow, and the song rests in a quiet, watched-over calm.
